Location
Sreenagar, Munshiganj
How to get there
Start at the Bikrampur Museum in Balasur. Ask locally which buildings belong to the heritage compound and which are private homes.
Access and opening hours
Public access varies by property. Ask for permission before entering or photographing private compounds.

Zamindari-era heritage

About this place

Bhagyakul and neighbouring Balasur are associated with zamindari-era houses. The heritage here belongs to an area, and a map search may return several buildings with similar names. The Jadunath Roy estate at Balasur provides a specific starting point through the Bikrampur Museum.

Treat residential compounds as private and check which property your guide or map listing refers to.
